listing.name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy (nxnative-aa-port)
listing.summary: Build Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy for Apple silicon Mac or iOS using your own Switch game and its 1.1.0 update. The project reports gameplay and a save/load fix. A complete trilogy playthrough remains unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare your base game and 1.1.0 update for title 0100CB000A142000, plus prod.keys. Use the patched_v196608 modules and matching extracted RomFS, shaders, fonts and save paths.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Select this title’s GAME setting in the Mac dm/host/dmhost source build. Use the project’s iOS script to make an IPA. There is no published player package.

warnings: Back up saves before changing builds. Save compatibility across updates is unconfirmed.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports keyboard, controller and mouse-as-touch input. Exact region, file hashes and other desktop platforms are unconfirmed.
